# Atmosphere

> Atmosphere is a free ambient sound and cinematic video mixer for focus, sleep, study and relaxation. It has no account requirement and offers individual sound-layer volume, saved and shareable mixes, Live Weather matching, Audio only, Quiet View and a desktop package.

## Primary pages

- [Open Atmosphere](https://yessur3808.github.io/atmosphere/): Interactive ambient sound player
- [Explore sound guides](https://yessur3808.github.io/atmosphere/discover.html): Index of intent- and atmosphere-specific guides
- [Install](https://yessur3808.github.io/atmosphere/install.html): Desktop application downloads and verification
- [Privacy](https://yessur3808.github.io/atmosphere/privacy.html): Data-handling and provider disclosure
- [Analytics](https://yessur3808.github.io/atmosphere/analytics.html): Measurement choices and exclusions
- [Audio credits](https://yessur3808.github.io/atmosphere/audio-credits.html): Recording sources and licenses
- [Video credits](https://yessur3808.github.io/atmosphere/video-credits.html): Video sources and licenses
